incidente.resumo: An erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases impacted their ability to respond to routing-service health check pings, the hosts were considered unhealthy and the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible, making all GitHub.com services inaccessible for 36 minutes. Service was restored by reverting the configuration change.

descricao.texto: An erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases impacted the ability of the database to respond to health check pings from the routing service; the database hosts were considered unhealthy, the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible, and the application could no longer connect to critical data for read operations.
trechos: At 22:59 UTC, an erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases that impacted the ability of the database to respond to health check pings from the routing service.
This led to these database hosts being considered unhealthy and the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible.
As a result, the application could no longer connect to critical data for read operations.

descricao.texto: An erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases at 22:59 UTC.
trechos: At 22:59 UTC, an erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases that impacted the ability of the database to respond to health check pings from the routing service.

passos.texto: The configuration change was reverted and restored connectivity to the databases was confirmed; at 23:38 UTC traffic resumed and all services recovered.
trechos: We mitigated the incident by reverting the configuration change and confirming restored connectivity to our databases.
At 23:38 UTC, traffic resumed and all services recovered to full health.

acoes.texto: Already done: additional guardrails were implemented in the database change management process.
trechos: To prevent recurrence we have implemented additional guardrails in our database change management process.

acoes.texto: Repair items are being prioritized, such as faster rollback functionality and more resilience to dependency failures.
trechos: We are also prioritizing several repair items, such as faster rollback functionality and more resilience to dependency failures.

observacoes: The text gives no year for the August 14 incident. The incident was formally resolved at 00:30 UTC on August 15 after a period of monitoring; the 36-minute duration covers the impact (23:02 to 23:38 UTC).
